description: Create a Prized box: a persistent cloud dev machine (Linux, with your own user and sudo) that keeps its files, tools and running work between sessions. This spends the workspace's money: a box bills while awake, and a smaller amount for its disk while paused (a Nano costs $10 a month awake around the clock; rates at https://prized.dev/docs/billing). Ask your person before creating one. It creates a Nano (2 vCPU, 2 GB memory, 40 GB disk) unless size names another, and never a GPU box. It waits until the box is running and returns its name, which the other box tools take. It pauses itself after 120 idle minutes unless auto_pause_minutes says otherwise, and is kept, files and all, until someone deletes it (the dashboard, or `prized box delete`); these tools do not delete boxes.

auto_pause_minutes.description: Pause after this many idle minutes, 30 to 10,080 (7 days). Default 120, so a box nobody uses stops billing for compute (or the workspace's own rule, when it sets a shorter one); on the free credit at most 720.

name.description: A name for the box, such as api-dev. Default: Prized picks one.

region.description: The AWS region. Default us-west-2 (US West, Oregon).

size.description: nano (default: Nano, 2 vCPU, 2 GB), micro (Micro, 2 vCPU, 4 GB), lite (Extra Small, 2 vCPU, 8 GB), flow (Small, 4 vCPU, 16 GB), pro (Medium, 8 vCPU, 32 GB), max (Large, 16 vCPU, 64 GB) or ultra (Extra Large, 32 vCPU, 128 GB). Bigger costs more; on the free credit only nano through flow start.

name: create_box

autoPauseMinutes.description: Idle minutes before it pauses itself, or null when it never does.

desiredState.description: Where it is headed: running, suspended or terminated.

region.description: Its AWS region, such as us-west-2.

size.description: Its size id, such as nano.

state.description: Where it is now: requested, provisioning, running, suspending, suspended, waking, deep_sleep, resizing and so on.

usable.description: Whether these tools act on it (a box you own, one this server created, or every box when the person allowed it).

title: Create a box (spends money)
